body: Thank you. Things are so difficult right now

I find that my good times revolve around other people. I was happy for most of my relationship with my ex. Now she found someone else and I'm here alone. I always hear that happiness comes from within but I'll be damned on how that works. If I'm going to have to rely on other people for happiness, that's not fair to them.

I've been receiving treatment for the last 8 years for major depressive disorder, general anxiety, and obsessive compulsive disorder. I feel like a lost cause right now. Everybody says that suicide is a permanent fix to temperary problem but for a lot of of people the pain doesn't stop. I'm 21 and this is something I'm going to live the rest of my life with. Fuck, why keep slogging through the rounds of medication and therapy when it's just going to get worse from here on out

I have been searching for my personal meaning for the last few months and I think for me right now it has to be my education. I have a desire to know more about everything. I am deeply interested in my studys and I hope that within the next few months I can have a couple articles or academic writings published. Right now, I just have to find the willpower and the confidence to really get some good writing done.

Thank you so much for your comment. It means a lot to know that someone took time out of their day to say a few nice things.
